description: The plot illustrates how **Accuracy (%)** varies with the **Number of Frames** for four methods, shown as four colored line series with markers and a legend. The x-axis is labeled **“Number of Frames”**, uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from **8 to 64** frames, with visible major ticks at **10-frame intervals** (10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60). The y-axis is labeled **“Accuracy (%)”**, uses a linear scale, and ranges from about **39% to 54%**, with labeled ticks at **2% intervals** (40, 42, 44, 46, 48, 50, 52, 54). The **blue** series (**“Ours (Dynamic Seg)”**) is a solid line with **circle** markers and starts near **53.0% at 8 frames**, rises to about **54.0% at 16 frames**, then stays near **53.8% at 32 frames** and ends around **53.7% at 64 frames**. The **green** series (**“Ours (Static 4-Seg)”**) is a solid line with **circle** markers and begins around **52.6% at 8 frames**, increases to about **53.6% at 16 frames**, reaches roughly **53.8% at 32 frames**, and ends near **53.8% at 64 frames**. The **orange** series (**“PLLaVA (DP 8)”**) is a solid line with **square** markers and decreases from about **45.0% at 8 frames** to roughly **43.0% at 16 frames**, then to about **41.0% at 32 frames**, ending near **39.5% at 64 frames**. The **red** series (**“PLLaVA (DP 16)”**) is a solid line with **square** markers and declines from about **45.6% at 16 frames** to around **44.0% at 32 frames**, ending near **42.1% at 64 frames**.
